title: ember-temporal-degradation: Reproducibility artifact for "Temporal Degradation in Machine Learning-Based Malware Detection: A Multi-Dataset, Multi-Year Empirical Study" (IEEE Access, 2026)
description: Source code, experiment scripts, data-cleaning pipeline, statistical analysis, and figure-generation code for the paper "Temporal Degradation in Machine Learning-Based Malware Detection: A Multi-Dataset, Multi-Year Empirical Study," published in IEEE Access, 2026 (DOI: 10.1109/ACCESS.2026.3706553). The artifact reproduces the full nine-experiment pipeline (temporal baselines, cross-era transfer, monthly drift, incremental retraining, family-level FNR decomposition, feature-group ablation, cumulative Area-Under-Time analysis, ADWIN/DDM-triggered retraining, and uncertainty-sampled active learning) over EMBER 2017, EMBER 2018, and BODMAS corpora in the EMBER v2 feature space (1,684,338 samples, 2017-2020).
